title: Episode I
description: There's something amiss in the small town of Primrose, and it's up to our outlaws to figure out what.

objectives.text: Enter Primrose point to find shelter and check out what's up with the town.

title: Achieving Infamy
description: What's a group of outlaws without a reputation to precede them?

objectives.text: Find allies or uncover new ways to build your reputation and value.
